issue.detail: Spec says recover GHR to state immediately after mispredicting branch, but contract does not specify whether train_history is that state or pre-branch state.
issue.spec_evidence: recover the branch history register to the state immediately after the mispredicting branch completes execution
issue.alternative: train_history is the GHR value before the mispredicting branch; recovery should shift in train_taken to form post-branch GHR.

issue.detail: Spec says training takes precedence when both modify GHR, but contract does not state whether prediction still updates GHR when train_valid=1 but train_mispredicted=0.
issue.spec_evidence: If training for a misprediction and a prediction (for a different, younger instruction) occurs in the same cycle, both operations will want to modify the branch history register. When this happens, training takes precedence
issue.alternative: Prediction updates GHR only when train_valid=0; any train_valid=1 suppresses prediction GHR update regardless of mispredicted.
